result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would eliminate the illusion of separation—the belief that we are fundamentally distinct from one another, from other species, and from the Earth itself.

This shift would dissolve the roots of greed, conflict, and exploitation, because you can’t harm what you recognize as part of yourself. It wouldn’t erase difference or individuality, but it would make cooperation as natural as breathing, creativity as boundless as curiosity, and care as instinctive as self-preservation.

The world wouldn’t become perfect, but it would stop being *broken* in the ways that cause the most suffering. And that’s a start.
